wrong: I have sent it yesterday.
right: I sent it yesterday.
rule: Momento cerrado (yesterday) → Simple Past.

wrong: I live here since 2020.
right: I've lived here since 2020.
rule: Duración hasta ahora con since/for → Present Perfect.

wrong: I work with Python for three years.
right: I've been working with Python for three years.
rule: Llevo X haciendo → Present Perfect Continuous + for.

wrong: If you will send me the file, I'll review it.
right: If you send me the file, I'll review it.
rule: Nunca will después de if: if + presente.

wrong: When I will arrive, I'll call you.
right: When I arrive, I'll call you.
rule: Nunca will después de when: when + presente.

wrong: I want that you check the code.
right: I want you to check the code.
rule: Querer que → want + persona + to.

wrong: I'm knowing the answer.
right: I know the answer.
rule: Know es verbo de estado: no va en continuo.

wrong: I have been in London last year.
right: I was in London last year.
rule: Last year → Simple Past.

wrong: If I would have more time, I would help.
right: If I had more time, I would help.
rule: Hipotético: if + Simple Past, sin would tras if.

wrong: I'm looking for be the best trader.
right: I'm trying to be the best trader.
rule: Looking for + sustantivo. Con un verbo, usa trying to o looking to.

wrong: I'm tired to be at the bottom.
right: I'm tired of being at the bottom.
rule: Tired of + verbo en -ing.

wrong: I'm learning English for better my life.
right: I'm learning English to make my life better.
rule: Para el objetivo: to + verbo, no for + adjetivo.

wrong: I want to improve mi live.
right: I want to improve my life.
rule: Mi es español: en inglés es my. Life es el sustantivo; live es el verbo.

wrong: Is so difficult find a job.
right: It's so difficult to find a job.
rule: Siempre hay sujeto (it) y adjetivo + to + verbo.

wrong: There are most demand than offer.
right: There are more candidates than jobs.
rule: More ... than, no most. Para empleo, jobs, no offer.

wrong: The consulting dont hire juniors.
right: Consulting companies don't hire junior people.
rule: Consulting companies, no the consulting. Don't lleva apóstrofo.

wrong: They want three years of experience or like that.
right: They want three years of experience or more.
rule: Or like that no existe. Se dice or something like that (o algo así).

wrong: They want experience, and obviously I don't have.
right: They want experience, and obviously I don't have that.
rule: Have necesita objeto (it, that). En español puedes omitirlo; en inglés no.

wrong: This is a really example.
right: This is a real example.
rule: Real es adjetivo (va antes del nombre). Really es adverbio (muy).

wrong: The image AI generative.
right: The image is AI generated.
rule: Falta el verbo is. Y es el participio -ed (generated), no -ive.

wrong: I'm exhausting.
right: I'm exhausted.
rule: -ed = cómo te sientes. -ing = lo que causa el cansancio.

wrong: The block was during one hour.
right: The block was supposed to last one hour.
rule: Duración = last, no during. Supposed to = se suponía que.

wrong: It's two hour already.
right: It's already been two hours.
rule: Hours en plural. Already va antes del participio.

wrong: Today I learn a little bit more than yesterday.
right: Today I learned a little more than yesterday.
rule: Acción terminada → pasado simple (learned).

wrong: I studied a master of data and ia.
right: I did a master's in data and AI.
rule: Master's in + tema. IA en inglés es AI.

wrong: I live in spain.
right: I live in Spain.
rule: Los países llevan mayúscula.

wrong: I want more oportunities.
right: I want more opportunities.
rule: Opportunities lleva dos p.

wrong: Bassicly, I want to learn.
right: Basically, I want to learn.
rule: Basically: una sola s y termina en -ally.

wrong: That a Comunity note.
right: That's a Community Note.
rule: Falta el 's de that's. Community lleva dos m.

wrong: Who I am?
right: Who am I?
rule: En preguntas directas, el verbo va antes del sujeto. I siempre en mayúscula.

wrong: And know I'll make it happen.
right: And now I'll make it happen.
rule: Now = ahora. Know = saber. Suenan parecido.

wrong: I'm trying to be a the best trader.
right: I'm trying to be the best trader.
rule: Un solo artículo.

wrong: I want to be the best in whole aspects of my life.
right: I want to be the best in all aspects of my life.
rule: Con plural: all aspects. Whole va con singular (the whole day).
